content: {"praised":["Stunning special effects and CGI backgrounds reminiscent of 1984.","Close‑quarter combat and unique hand‑to‑hand pistol battle.","Action sci‑fi vibe similar to Matrix, but better.","Engaging visual style with intense gun‑fights.","Strong thematic focus on authoritarian control and rebellion."],"criticized":["Plot is nonsensical and serves only fight scenes.","Main character lacks dynamic internal change.","Excessive talking makes pacing slow and boring.","Premise feels overly idealistic and unrealistic.","Film relies too heavily on violence without depth."]}
